text:
carlos: quick heads-up — we need to lock scope for the console observability work for the next sprint. customers pushing for dashboards (cost + error), lightweight trace hooks, and a cheaper sampling story. wanna run a short checklist to trade things off.

josh: +1. can we start with a customer-impact vs effort matrix? i think we should gate on SLA-impacting visibility first.

mika: can you list the specific asks? some look overlapping with eng-runtime telemetry changes.

carlos: sure, high-level asks from CS: 1) per-model cost breakdown in console, 2) error-slice analytics (grouped by model/route), 3) tracing hook to attach request->model variant spans, 4) sampling control to avoid high-cost dashboards for low-volume routes.

emily: CS can surface two enterprise customers that need per-model cost now — it's a deal blocker for Dedicated. flagged in support tickets #4521 and #4590.

priya: FYI eng-infra has a ~3 day spike to expose per-token counters via metrics pipeline. after that, console can consume.

anna: if we expose more traces, SRE needs retention knobs plumbed. otherwise alerts noise will explode.

leo: tracing hook work is small in runtime (add span annotations) but the UI side to visualize path+kv will take more time. estimate: runtime 2 dev-days, ui 6 dev-days.

josh: sounds like we need a checklist with acceptance criteria and fallback policy. proposing a prioritized list and what to cut if timeboxed to 2 weeks.

carlos: agree. draft checklist (acceptance + fallback) — please react with :thumbsup: if ok or suggest cuts.

Acceptance checklist v0.1
- Per-model cost: show token + infra cost aggregated per model for last 7d in cost UI (linked to route level)
  - AC: numbers match billing within 5% (sampled load)
  - Fallback: show token counts only if infra calc not ready
- Error-slice analytics: group errors by route/model, show top 10 slices and recent traces
  - AC: can filter by model and timeframe
  - Fallback: list top error messages with counts (no traces)
- Tracing hooks: emit span for model select + inference duration, attach model variant metadata
  - AC: span appears in traces within 5s of request completion
  - Fallback: emit only timing metrics (no span tags)
- Sampling control: per-route sampling rate toggle in console (5/10/20/100%)
  - AC: toggles affect sampling within 5 min
  - Fallback: global sampling config only

priya: checklist looks good. one ask: make the fallback paths explicit in the rollout notes so sales can promise partial visibility.

emily: will confirm with the two customers which features are must-have vs nice-to-have. i'll push for per-model cost as must-have.

mika: engineering constraints: if we cut UI work, we can ship runtime+metrics hooks first and wire a simple table in console. that's the low-effort fallback.

anna: regarding alerts — add a note: default trace retention 24h for non-enterprise, 30d for enterprise. toggles should be opt-in.

josh: new proposal: priority order for a 2-week sprint: 1) per-model token counters + simple table UI, 2) tracing hooks runtime + emit tags, 3) basic sampling control (global toggle), 4) full per-model cost calc & error-slice UI as stretch.

carlos: i like it. rename "basic sampling control" to "global sampling with rollout config" so PMs know it's not per-route initially.

josh: updated. can we ship a customer-facing note describing partial shipping plan and expected timelines? emily to own customer comms.

emily: i can. will draft a short note: what we ship day 1, what comes as stretch, and fallbacks. target: tomorrow EOD.

leo: small dev detail: runtime will tag spans with `model.name` and `model.variant`. please ensure privacy review if model identifiers tie to customer data.

carlos: good call. @anna can you confirm privacy/compliance for including model identifiers in traces?

anna: quick check — model IDs themselves are fine, but we must avoid embedding prompt text or PII in span tags. add that to ACs.

ci-bot: deploy-notify: draft branch created for `obs-cost-error-tracing` by mika — CI queued.

mika: i'll pick up runtime + metrics pipeline tasks, priya can help with metrics infra. josh, can you prioritize UI tasks and assign owners?

josh: will create tickets after this thread and tag owners. plan to triage in tomorrows 10:30 sync.

carlos: ok team — next steps: 1) emily sends customer comms, 2) josh creates UI tickets, 3) mika/priya start runtime + metrics infra. we'll reconvene in the 10:30 sync to confirm scope cuts. thanks. :white_check_mark:
